The deepseek model successfully reviewed all 5 files including .gitignore and correctly found them all safe. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), but this file is not security-relevant as it cannot execute code or affect the build process
learnings: Tool errors (API failures) on non-security-critical files like .gitignore should not force an 'inconclusive' verdict when all security-relevant files have been successfully reviewed and found safe
The audit tool should distinguish between tool failures and genuine security uncertainty when determining final verdicts
Models should be instructed that .gitignore files are not security-relevant and their review failure should not block a verdict
